content.reason: The draft attributes the 500 codebases, 50% commit‑to‑push reduction, and 3× PR velocity to ShipBob, but the evidence only contains a generic anecdote about scaling (500 repositories, 50% reduction, 3× velocity) with no link to ShipBob.
